issues.body: The new note explicitly retains floor 90 from the default-feature 92.02% measurement and defers re-seeding until after merge. The mandatory shard does resolve one part of round 1's concern: it prevents this PR from merging if with-Datalog coverage is below 90. It does not resolve the ratchet-seeding problem when coverage is at or above 90, because the gate only compares against the stale floor; it does not update that floor to floor(the new measurement)-2. Thus this PR can land with a materially looser floor than the expanded surface supports, contrary to the documented seed procedure, and the committed note remains an admission that the entry is not a measurement of what scripts/coverage.sh now measures.
issues.fix_hint: Use the result from the PR's required coverage shard (or reproduce its pinned command), then update sparq-reason's floor to floor(the with-Datalog line percentage)-2 via the normal seed/monotonic-review procedure and replace the carried-forward/unmeasured note with the actual measurement. If the measured result yields 90, record that evidence explicitly; if the shard is not yet green, keep the PR open until it produces the measurement.
issues.title: Expanded-denominator coverage floor remains unseeded

verdict.summary: Round 2 explains correctly that the changed coverage command is a full-run trigger and that a sub-90 measurement will block merge, but it still does not supply the with-Datalog measurement or seed the ratchet from that measurement. The prior major finding therefore remains: the committed floor is knowingly derived from a different denominator, while tightening to the first measured expanded-surface result is deferred. CI can establish that 90 is not too high; it cannot make 90 the repository's intended floor(measured)-2 seed when the actual result is higher. Record the expanded-surface measurement and update the floor/note in this PR.
